findings.description: When using `[[Target Page|the home page]]`, `label = m.group(1).strip()` is passed to `build_url`, meaning `build_url` receives `'Main Page|the home page'` instead of just `'Main Page'`, resulting in an incorrect URL containing the pipe and label text.

summary: The pull request implements support for `[[Target|text]]` in wikilinks, but has a critical bug: `label` passed to `build_url` includes the `|text` part (e.g. `Main Page|the home page`), leading to an incorrect URL. `label` needs to be split before calling `build_url`.

requirements.requirement: The part before | builds the URL exactly like it does today (same base_url, end_url, html_class and build_url handling)
The part after | is the text of the link
Plain [[Main Page]] keeps working exactly as now
